text:
sarah-sales: Hey team — AcmeHealth is ready to scope a 2-week pilot for a telemed triage PoC. They want: representative success criteria, a safe way to share sample clinical notes, and a quick pricing estimate. They asked for ~10k notes (we can start with a 2k sample) + ~500 synthetic queries. Also flag: legal wants a security questionnaire answered before any data transfer.

mike-se: Got it. For evaluation we'll want 3 buckets: relevance/intent (precision/recall), hallucination checks (manual spot-checks), and latency/SLA. Ask the customer for 50 golden prompts with expected outputs. For dataset: CSV with columns [id, note_text, redacted_fields] or NDJSON. Prefer S3 signed URLs to ingest into a temporary "redwood-pilot" bucket.

tony-ops: Networking constraints noted — Acme says no open egress. Options: 1) VPC peering (Private deployment) 2) S3 -> SSM transfer via ephemeral IAM proxy 3) Customer uploads to our secure collector VPN endpoint. For hosted POC only signed S3 presigned URLs over TLS allowed with DPA in place. We can provision an IAM fetch role with least privilege. Example policy snippet: ```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [{
    "Effect": "Allow",
    "Action": ["s3:GetObject"],
    "Resource": ["arn:aws:s3:::acme-pilot-sample/*"]
  }]
}
```
Use short-lived creds; we'll rotate keys every 6 hours.

jess-ps: Suggested concrete success criteria: - Entity extraction F1 >= 0.85 on labeled sample - Hallucination rate < 2% on random 300-note audit - Median inference latency <= 120ms (512-token equivalent) - Throughput: sustain 20 req/s on Dedicated pilot config. Also want to capture human-in-the-loop correction rate (target < 10%). For prompts/evals: SE to produce harness with 50 gold prompts + 200 auto-eval cases.

laura-eng: Model guidance: start with rwinference-v2-small for the pilot (best latency), and run a parallel eval on rwinference-v2-medium for quality comparison. Recommend enabling KV-cache and prefix caching for repeated templates. Routing policy: primary -> small, fallback -> medium if small saturates. Also enable token-rate limiting during the pilot to control costs.

nate-infosec: Legal/Sec notes: Acme requires SOC2 attestation + data residency in us-east-1. They also provided a 20-page security questionnaire — we need to return answers before any sample transfer. Blocker: their procurement insists on a signed DPA and a one-off IP allowlist prior to ingestion. I'll draft responses; please share any network diagrams. :lock:  

infra-bot: Provisioning ticket created: PRJ-1234. Owner: tony-ops. Estimated spin-up: 2 business days.

sarah-sales: Action items summary & owners: 1) ask Acme for 50 golden prompts + 2k redacted sample (they'll provide redacted + mask) — owner: Acme / sarah-sales. 2) SE to build eval harness and cost estimate (owner: mike-se). 3) Ops to propose transfer options and IAM proxy guide (owner: tony-ops). 4) InfoSec to return security questionnaire + DPA (owner: nate-infosec). 5) Engineering to pick model variants and defaults (owner: laura-eng). Sync scheduled Wed 10:00am ET. @mike-se can you own the eval harness & cost calc? :calendar: 

mike-se: Yep — I'll draft the eval harness and a 2-week cost estimate (hosted vs dedicated pilot). Quick rough numbers: expected token volume ~ 2M tokens -> hosted estimate ~$400 (quantized example), Dedicated short-term bump ~ $800 provisioning overhead + lower per-token. I'll post a detailed breakdown before Wed.

sarah-sales: Perfect — thanks everyone. I'll push the questionnaire to Acme and ask for the sample links. If legal pushes the DPA, loop Nate. :thumbsup:
